Definition: from G5312; an elevated place or thing, i.e. (abstractly) altitude, or (by implication) a barrier (figuratively):-- height, high thing.
BiblicalUsage: hýpsōma is a plain word for height, a high place. In Romans 8:39, the text says "Nor height."
TheologicalSignificance: This word, hýpsōma, does its job quietly — height, a high place — and I leave it at that.
